'''Rythii beasts''' were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rydonni Prime]] and were often present in the [[Royal Zoos]]. The lumbering gait of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] was reminiscent of the way Rythii beasts moved.<ref name="Easy">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref>
